zh.nbStorageSubtitle: 为笔记资料选择长期保存的位置。
zh.nbStorageReloaded: 已刷新当前存储位置。输入框中的待保存路径已保留。
zh.nbStorageUnavailable: 暂时无法读取存储位置
zh.nbStoragePathHint: 填写运行 DeepSeek Harness 的电脑上的绝对目录路径，例如 D:\Notes 或 \\server\share\Notes。留空使用应用默认存储位置。
zh.nbStoragePathPlaceholder: 例如 D:\Notes；留空使用默认位置
zh.nbStorageChecked: 路径检查通过。保存后才会切换存储位置。
zh.nbStoragePreserve: 应用会在所选目录的 dsh-notebook 文件夹中管理笔记、历史版本、对话关联及笔记附件。切换时保留笔记 ID、搜索内容和附件引用，并保留原位置的数据作为备份。需要 Markdown 文件时，可使用笔记导出。
zh.nbStorageApplyHint: 检查路径或清空输入框不会立即切换位置。
zh.nbStorageApplyingHint: 正在保存当前笔记并切换存储位置，请保持此窗口打开，等待完成。
zh.nbStorageApplied: 存储位置已保存。笔记、历史版本及对话关联已保留。
zh.nbStorageAppliedRefresh: 存储位置已保存，但刷新显示时出现问题。请刷新当前存储位置以确认。
zh.nbStorageFlushError: 当前笔记尚未成功保存。请先处理笔记中的保存问题，再切换存储位置；本次未提交位置更改。
zh.nbStorageLoadError: 暂时无法读取当前存储位置。请刷新后重试。
zh.nbStorageCheckError: 路径检查未通过。请检查目录路径与访问权限。
zh.nbStorageInvalidDirectory: 目录不可用。请输入运行应用的电脑上的有效绝对路径。
zh.nbStorageDirectoryBusy: 目录正被使用或无法接收这批笔记数据。请查看下方详细信息后重试。
zh.nbStorageConflict: 存储位置已在其他地方更改。已更新当前位置信息，请核对输入的目标路径后再次保存。
zh.nbStorageApplyUnconfirmed: 暂时无法确认位置更改的结果。应用可能仍在处理，请刷新当前存储位置并确认后再重试。
zh.nbStorageBrowseHint: 浏览运行 DeepSeek Harness 的电脑上的文件夹。选择后先填入路径，保存并切换后才会应用。
zh.nbStorageBrowseEmpty: 此目录下没有子文件夹。
zh.nbStorageBrowseError: 无法读取文件夹，请检查路径或访问权限。
zh.nbStorageHostUnavailable: 笔记服务尚未就绪。请确认插件已启用，且资料目录未被其他实例占用。

en.nbStorageSubtitle: Choose where your notebook data is kept.
en.nbStorageReloaded: Current storage location refreshed. Your pending path is still in the input field.
en.nbStoragePathHint: Enter an absolute directory path on the computer running DeepSeek Harness, such as D:\Notes or \\server\share\Notes. Leave it blank to use application default storage.
en.nbStoragePathPlaceholder: For example, D:\Notes; blank uses the default
en.nbStorageChecked: Path check passed. The location will change only after you save.
en.nbStorageCheckedHint: Path is available; the change has not been applied.
en.nbStoragePreserve: The application manages notes, history, conversation links and note attachments in a dsh-notebook folder inside your chosen directory. Switching preserves note IDs, searchable content and attachment references, and keeps source copies. Use note export when you need Markdown files.
en.nbStorageApplyHint: Checking the path or clearing the field does not switch the location.
en.nbStorageApplyingHint: Saving the current note and switching storage. Keep this window open until the operation finishes.
en.nbStorageApplied: Storage location saved. Notes, history and conversation links have been preserved.
en.nbStorageAppliedRefresh: Storage location saved, but the display could not be refreshed. Refresh the current location to confirm it.
en.nbStorageFlushError: The current note could not be saved. Resolve its save problem before switching storage; no location change was submitted.
en.nbStorageLoadError: The current storage location could not be read. Refresh it and try again.
en.nbStorageCheckError: The path check failed. Check the directory path and its access permissions.
en.nbStorageInvalidDirectory: This directory is unavailable. Enter a valid absolute path on the computer running the application.
en.nbStorageDirectoryBusy: The directory is in use or cannot receive this notebook data. Review the details below before trying again.
en.nbStorageConflict: The storage location changed elsewhere. Current location information has been updated; review your target path and save again.
en.nbStorageApplyUnconfirmed: The outcome of the location change could not be confirmed. The application may still be processing it; refresh the current location and confirm it before retrying.
en.nbStorageBrowseHint: Browse folders on the computer running DeepSeek Harness. Selecting a folder fills the path; use Save and switch to apply it.
en.nbStorageBrowseError: The folder could not be read. Check its path and access permissions.
en.nbStorageHostUnavailable: The notebook service is unavailable. Check that the plugin is enabled and the data directory is not in use by another instance.
